verdict.rationale: Browser Use has a dedicated CAPTCHA-handling doc page. It states that automatic solving is on by default for Cloud browsers and V4 Agent runs, limited to 'supported' challenges. It also documents a human fallback: open the live preview and take control if a challenge remains. Together these give an explicit, documented stance rather than silent failure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that solving works, an enumeration of which CAPTCHA types are supported, and a documented stance for the local open-source library.
